_notes.history: 2026-10-13: the first set (music box, children's march, storybook piano) was too slow and babyish; replaced with these higher-energy adventure tracks
_notes.repeat: short seamless loops are repeated inside the file so each play runs about two minutes without an MP3 gap at the seam
_notes.format: MP3 plays in every browser (Safari included) and streams through an <audio> element
_notes.loudness: two-pass EBU R128 loudnorm to the same integrated level, so the game sets the music level in one place
